description: This source file defines a helper class 'DatatableHelper' for managing data tables within the Fineract project. It includes methods for creating, querying, updating, and deleting data tables and their entries, primarily used in integration testing scenarios. The class also contains static methods for generating test data and column configurations for data tables. It is annotated with deprecation notices indicating plans for rewriting to utilize a newer client API.

classes.name: DatatableHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to manage and interact with data tables in Fineract's integration tests, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and generating test data.

methods.name: createDatatable
methods.description: Creates a new data table on the server using various overloads, either by JSON string, request object, or using deprecated methods.

methods.name: getDataTableDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific data table by name.

methods.name: runDatatableQuery
methods.description: Executes a query against a data table with specified filters and returns the results as JSON.

methods.name: queryDatatable
methods.description: Performs an advanced query on a data table using specific request parameters.

methods.name: updateDatatable
methods.description: Updates an existing data table either by request object or JSON string.

methods.name: deleteDatatable
methods.description: Deletes a data table by its name.

methods.name: createDatatableEntry
methods.description: Creates a new entry in a specified data table, with overloads for different parameter sets.

methods.name: addDatatableEntry
methods.description: Adds an entry to a data table for a specific app table ID, returning a response object.

methods.name: readDatatableEntry
methods.description: Reads a data table entry, optionally with an index position or resource ID.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing data table entry with new data.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntry
methods.description: Overloaded method to update a specific entry in a data table based on entry ID.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntry
methods.description: Updates an entire data table entry with provided JSON.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntries
methods.description: Deletes entries from a data table for a given app table ID.

methods.name: getTestDatatableAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string defining a test data table configuration with columns, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTestDatatableEntryAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for a test data table entry with sample data.

methods.name: addDatatableColumn
methods.description: Adds a column definition to the list of data table columns for test setup.

methods.name: addDatatableColumnWithUniqueAndIndex
methods.description: Adds a column with additional attributes like uniqueness and indexing to the list of data table columns.
